profile.headline: Engineer Navigating the AI Era: Passionate about AI News and Open-Source Projects
profile.summary:
Versatile GenAI Operations and Software Engineering Expert
Experienced professional with over 9 years of expertise in high-speed LLM fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), distributed training optimization (DeepSpeed, FSDP), and low-latency AI deployment. Certified Google ML expert with a proven track record in scaling LLMs for enterprise applications and building innovative AI infrastructure, including a $15k on-prem server for accelerated R&D of training/inference solutions.
Additionally, an accomplished Lead Software Engineer with more than 8 years of experience in full-stack development (.NET, Python, HTML, CSS, JS, SQL, and MongoDB), mobile applications, database administration (SQL, MongoDB Atlas), and data analytics. Specializing in developing generative AI models, MLOps pipelines, and robust web applications. Combines advanced AI expertise with full-stack engineering skills to deliver cutting-edge, scalable, and impactful solutions.

positions.title: Lead ML Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the development of generative AI models to produce high-quality, SEO-optimized article websites, significantly enhancing content generation capabilities.

- Accelerated LoRA fine-tuning for Mixtral-8x7B by 3.5x using DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 and 8xA100 GPUs, achieving 18,000 tokens/sec throughput.

- Slashed training costs by 65% via QLoRA (4-bit quantization) while retaining 99% accuracy on content moderation tasks.

- Deployed dynamic LoRA adapters with Triton Inference Server, reducing latency by 40% for 500k+ daily RAG queries.


- Engineered a comprehensive MLOps pipeline for training, inferencing, quantization, testing, and deployment, primarily utilizing Python, which streamlined model development processes.

- Developed a web job application in C# SQL DB to interface with the Python-based ML API wrapper, facilitating seamless integration between front-end applications and machine learning models.

- Implemented robust fallback mechanisms in the serverless C# web job to ensure system resilience under load, enabling alternative services to manage requests efficiently.

- Designed and executed TDD functions to interact with various AI API endpoints, supporting diverse AI-driven tasks, including image, video, and audio generation, thus broadening the system's applicability.
- Leveraged cutting-edge technology, including Nvidia RTX 4090 and A6000 GPUs, for local model testing and development, ensuring high performance and efficiency.

positions.title: CEO
positions.description:
- Built $15k AI Research Server: On-prem cluster (8x NVIDIA RTX 4090, 256GB RAM) for testing distributed training/inference, reducing cloud costs by 40%.

- Deployed quantized LoRA adapters on edge devices (Jetson TX2), achieving 80% faster inference for real-time ad generation.

- Engineered hybrid search RAG with FAISS and Pinecone, improving recall@5 by 30%.

- AI partnerships and consulting with multiple companies.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Desarrollo de software · Finanzas · Liderazgo
